from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Metrics for a single university extracted from its CDS report."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university/institution")
    degrees_awarded: int | None = Field(description="Total bachelor's degrees awarded for the 2020-2021 academic year")
    graduation_rate: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate for the Fall 2015 cohort, as a percentage (e.g. 73.5)")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The academic year or period for the data, e.g. '2020-2021'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityMetrics]
